test_title: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper (Held On: 12th September 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Change the following from active to passive:**

Researchers can seldom obtain classified laboratory data without approval.

options.text: Classified laboratory data can seldom being obtained without approval.
Classified laboratory data could seldom be obtained without approval.
Classified laboratory data can seldom be obtained without approval.
Classified laboratory data are seldom able to be obtained without approval.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Researchers can seldom obtain classified laboratory data without approval."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "classified laboratory data" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "can obtain" to "can be obtained" (modal verb passive).
 
• Ensure the adverb "seldom" remains in the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Classified laboratory data can seldom being obtained without approval." – Incorrect usage of "being."
 
• **Option 2: **"Classified laboratory data could seldom be obtained without approval." – Incorrect modal verb "could" instead of "can."
 
• **Option 4: **"Classified laboratory data are seldom able to be obtained without approval." – Incorrect phrasing "are seldom able to be obtained."
